desc:
Life of an Otaku is a singleplayer showcase where you play the protagonist of the story and fix up your parents' old home in rural Japan.

This experience was originally created back in 2015 and was updated for the next three years. Since then, it has been occasionally updated so it doesn't completely break. 

Update log, controls, & more:
https://devforum.roblox.com/t/life-of-an-otaku/138149
